sqls.sql: INSERT INTO TEST_TASK_LIST ( TASK_ID, TASK_TYPE, DTL_TYPE, DEVICE, SYS_RECD_CRET_DT, TASK_ADR, TEST_STATUS, TEST_RESULT, ERR_MSG, RUN_DATE, REQ_PROD_SEQ, EXE_CD, PREF_RANK, CHORD_ID, CHORD_NM, CHORD_TYPE, CHORD_SBST, RESERVE_DATE, RESOURCE, SYS_TRTR_ID ) VALUES ( :task_Id, :task_Type, :dtl_Type, :device, :sys_Recd_Cret_Dt, :task_Adr, :test_Status, :test_Result, :err_Msg, :run_Date, :req_Prod_Seq, :exe_Cd, :pref_Rank, :chord_Id, :chord_Nm, :chord_Type, :chord_Sbst, :reserve_Date, :resource, :sys_Trtr_Id )
UPDATE TEST_TASK_LIST SET TEST_STATUS = :test_Status, TEST_RESULT = :test_Result, ERR_MSG = :err_Msg, RUN_DATE = :run_Date WHERE TASK_ID = :task_Id
SELECT * FROM TEST_TASK_LIST WHERE TASK_TYPE <> 'RESERVATION' ORDER BY SYS_RECD_CRET_DT DESC, TASK_ID DESC
SELECT * FROM TEST_TASK_LIST WHERE TASK_TYPE = 'RESERVATION' ORDER BY SYS_RECD_CRET_DT DESC, TASK_ID DESC
SELECT * FROM TEST_TASK_LIST WHERE TASK_TYPE <> 'RESERVATION' AND TEST_STATUS = 'RDY' ORDER BY SYS_RECD_CRET_DT, TASK_ID
SELECT * FROM TEST_TASK_LIST WHERE TASK_TYPE = 'RESERVATION' AND TEST_STATUS IN ('RDY', 'WAIT') ORDER BY RESERVE_DATE, TASK_ID
SELECT * FROM TEST_TASK_DTL WHERE TASK_ID = :task_Id ORDER BY DATA_SEQ, ACT_NO
